text:
Main aapki ghabrahat aur emergency poori tarah samajh raha hoon. Maine aapka yeh mamla seedhe senior delivery manager ke paas escalate kar diya hai aur priority mark karwaya hai. 

Aapko bina ek bhi second waste kiye human agent abhi call ya connect kar rahe hain jo isko manually override karke aaj hi delivery ka koi alternative ya direct dispatch arrange karwayenge. Kripya line par bane rahein.
